_about: Public-domain Robert Govett (1813-1901, Surrey Chapel, Norwich) for the Word Hoard: 7 named works from Internet Archive scans, 1841-1922: Isaiah Unfulfilled (1841), Not Water Baptism (1844), Infant Sprinkling No Baptism (1858), Christ's Resurrection and Ours (1876), The Bride's Bath (1876), The Apocalypse Expounded by Scripture (abridged, 1920) and Entrance into the Kingdom, Part I (second edition, 1922). Raw OCR. His many anonymous Norwich tracts are listed as alternates, not shelved. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

govett-isaiah-unfulfilled: Isaiah Unfulfilled: an Exposition of the Prophet, with New Version and Critical Notes (London: James Nisbet, MDCCCXLI)
govett-not-water-baptism: Not Water Baptism, but the Gifts of the Holy Spirit the Baptism of Christ (Norwich: Josiah Fletcher; London: Hamilton, Adams, 1844)
govett-infant-sprinkling: Infant Sprinkling No Baptism: a Refutation of Mr. C. Paget's Godly Practice of Infant Baptism (London: Houlston and Wright, 1858)
govett-christs-resurrection: Christ's Resurrection and Ours; or, I. Corinthians XV. Expounded (Glasgow: James Maclehose; London: Macmillan, 1876)
govett-brides-bath: The Bride's Bath (Norwich: Fletcher and Son, MDCCCLXXVI)
govett-apocalypse-expounded: The Apocalypse Expounded by Scripture, abridged from the four-volume edition first issued under the pen-name Mathetes (London: Chas. J. Thynne, November 1920)
govett-entrance-kingdom: Entrance into the Kingdom; or, Reward According to Works, Part I, second edition (London: Charles J. Thynne, October 1922)

_alternates.govett-anonymous-tracts: Anonymous Norwich tracts catalogued to him, no name on the title page: The Passage through the Red Sea a Type of Baptism (passagethroughre00gove), Baptism Foreshadowed by Noah's Salvation (baptismforeshado00gove), Principal Arguments in favour of Infant Baptism Considered (principalargumen00gove), Open or Strict Communion? (openorstrictcomm00gove, 1845), Sin after Baptism (sinafterbaptismo00gove, 1845), At Any Rate, Infant Baptism is Not Forbidden (atanyrateinfantb00gove, 1847), Your Children Holy (yourchildrenholy00gove, 1857), Infant Baptism and the Abrahamic Covenant (infantbaptismabr00gove, 1860)
_alternates.govett-olivet: The Prophecy on Olivet, Part I (Norwich, 1846; prophecyonolive00ofgoog): anonymous; attributed to him from an advertisement in his 1847 tract
_alternates.govett-english-hebrew: English Derived from Hebrew (1869; englishderivedf00govegoog): philology, not divinity
_alternates.govett-apocalypse-copies: Other copies of the 1920 abridgment, and the 1929 Thynne and Jarvis printing

_excluded.govett-calvinism: Calvinism by Calvin: Calvin's text with his introductory essay, modern reprint
